exhibit-a.summary: The cost-structure chart shows COGS, labor, overhead and profit as shares of revenue for each year of the period.

definitions.text: Net profit margin is what is left of revenue after COGS, labor and overhead, as a share of revenue.
The margin impact of COGS is the rise in COGS as a share of revenue valued at today's revenue, not the growth in COGS spending, which includes revenue growth.
Revenue per store is total annual revenue divided by the number of stores.

definitions.term: beans as a share of revenue
definitions.text: Beans' earlier share of revenue is beans' share of COGS times COGS as a share of revenue, both from before the increase.
Bean inflation's contribution to the COGS increase is beans' earlier share of revenue times the bean price change, in points of revenue.

definitions.term: other inputs as a share of revenue
definitions.text: Other inputs' share of revenue today is their earlier share, COGS less beans, scaled up by their price change.
Other inputs' contribution to the COGS increase is their share of revenue today less their earlier share, in points of revenue.
